_about: Polish1 F3 (item 130): the farm animals of the fantasy world, show only (game/fantasy_livestock.gd; each machine keeps its own, nothing is sent). kinds: model = a creature model (assets/models/fantasy/creatures/), pace = walking speed m/s, roam_m = how far it strays from its spot, rest_s = [shortest, longest] it stands grazing between walks, shy_m = it steps away from a player this close. herds: which animals a place keeps, looked up by the place's layout, else by its kind; 'site:<kind>' for the small sites between places. Each entry: kind, count, ring = [from, to] as shares of the place's flat radius where they graze (ring_m = metres, for sites). show_m = a herd is built inside this distance, near_m = inside this its animals walk and cast shadows, most = animals built at once. cart = the ox and cart a carter on the road leads (people with 'cart' in game/fantasy_places.gd): metres behind the carter where the ox walks and the cart's axle rolls, shafts_deg = how far the cart is tipped up to the ox.
